topic: Present Perfect vs Past Simple: Farqlar va signallar
theory: Agar ish-harakat aniq o'tgan vaqtda tugagan bo'lsa (yesterday, in 2020, ago, last week) — Past Simple ishlatiladi. Agar ish-harakat natijasi hozirgi paytga bog'liq bo'lsa yoki vaqt aniq aytilmagan bo'lsa (already, yet, just, ever, never, so far) — Present Perfect (have/has + V3) ishlatiladi.
formula: Past Simple: S + V2/ed  |  Present Perfect: S + have/has + V3

example.problem: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'I (lose) my key yesterday, but I (find) it already.'
example.solution: 'yesterday' bo'lgani uchun 'lost' (Past Simple), ikkinchi gapda 'already' natijani ko'rsatgani uchun 'have found' (Present Perfect). To'g'ri javob: lost / have found.

practice.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: She has lived in London in 2019.
She has lived in London yesterday.
She lives in London two years ago.
practice.hint: 'in 2019' aniq o'tgan zamon bo'lgani sababli faqat Past Simple (lived) to'g'ri bo'ladi.

topic: Passive Voice: Majhul nisbat formulasi va qo'llanishi
theory: Majhul nisbatda (Passive Voice) ish-harakatni kim bajarganligi emas, balki obyekt ustida nima sodir bo'lganligi muhim hisoblanadi. Asosiy formula har doim 'to be + V3 (Past Participle)' ko'rinishida bo'ladi.
formula: Object + to be (zamonga mos) + V3 + (by Subject)

example.problem: Active: 'Shakespeare wrote Hamlet.' Ushbu gapni Passive Voice ga o'tkazing.
example.solution: 'wrote' bu Past Simple. 'Hamlet' birlikda, demak to be 'was' bo'ladi: 'Hamlet was written by Shakespeare.'

practice.question: Change into Passive: 'They build new houses every year.'
options: New houses were built every year.
New houses are built every year.
New houses has been built every year.
New houses are building every year.
practice.correct: New houses are built every year.
practice.hint: 'every year' Present Simple ni bildiradi, ko'plikda (houses) 'are built' ishlatiladi.

topic: Conditional Sentences: First and Second Conditionals
theory: First Conditional — kelajakda amalga oshishi mumkin bo'lgan real shartlar uchun (If + Present Simple, will + V1). Second Conditional — hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi nohaqiqiy, orzu-xayoliy shartlar uchun (If + Past Simple, would + V1).
formula: 1st: If + Present Simple, will + V1  |  2nd: If + Past Simple, would + V1

example.problem: Qavsni oching: 'If I (win) the lottery tomorrow, I would travel around the world.'
example.solution: Natija qismida 'would travel' (2nd Conditional) turgani sababli, If qismida Past Simple bo'ladi: 'won'. If I won...

practice.question: Complete the sentence: 'If it rains tomorrow, we _______ the picnic.'
practice.hint: 'If it rains' bu Present Simple (real shart), shuning uchun asosiy gapda 'will cancel' ishlatiladi.

topic: Modal Verbs: Must, Should, Have to, May farqlari
theory: 'Must' — shaxsiy qat'iy majburiyat yoki kuchli qoida. 'Have to' — tashqi shart-sharoit taqozosi bo'lgan majburiyat. 'Should' — maslahat yoki tavsiya (qilsa yaxshi bo'lardi). 'Mustn't' — qat'iy taqiq, 'Don't have to' esa majbur emaslikni bildiradi.
formula: Must / Should + V1  |  Have/Has to + V1  |  Mustn't (taqiq) ≠ Don't have to (ixtiyoriy)

example.problem: 'You _______ wear a uniform at this lyceum; it is a school rule.'
example.solution: Maktab nizomi bo'yicha tashqi qoida bo'lgani sababli 'have to' yoki 'must' ishlatiladi. Rasmiy qoidalarda 'must / have to' to'g'ri.

practice.question: Choose the best option: 'You _______ touch this wire. It is extremely dangerous!'
practice.hint: Xavfli holatdagi qat'iy taqiq uchun 'mustn't' (mumkin emas!) ishlatiladi.
